# F17: The import’s preview on a phone: nothing scrolls sideways, every answer and button is 44 px high, Import’s primary action is on the first screen

A check of the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/17-import.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

the import's preview on a phone (IM3, docs/design/import/spec.md section 10). At 390 × 844 and 360 × 800: Import, the preview (with groups, answered and not) and the changes don't scroll sideways; every answer and button there is at least 44 px high; the primary action is on Import's first screen. (Imported, Past imports, Undo and Export come with IM4 and IM7.)

## Where it looks

- 390 × 844, as amara, at `'/data/import', true`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day.
